title: Flawed Helldusk Gloves

sources.title: Lesser Infernal Touch
markers: | description = Your weapon attacks deal an additional {{DamageText|1d4|Fire}} damage. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional {{DamageText|1d4|Necrotic}} damage, and can possibly inflict {{Cond|Bleeding}}.

summary: Gain +1 Strength saves. Weapon attacks add 1d4 Fire. Unarmed attacks add 1d4 Necrotic and force DC 13 Constitution against Bleeding for 2 turns.

fields.Crafting: Dammon crafts the gloves after receiving a third piece of Infernal Iron.
fields.Base value: 290 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Lesser Infernal Touch: Weapon hits deal an extra 1d4 Fire. Unarmed hits deal an extra 1d4 Necrotic and can inflict Bleeding for 2 turns on a failed DC 13 Constitution save.
fields.Reported throwing behavior: Thrown weapon attacks can apply both the extra Fire damage and Bleeding. The Bleeding save is hidden in the combat log.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
